records.title: Iran and US hit tankers in biggest wave of attacks on shipping since war began
records.claim: Iran said it attacked 10 ships near Hormuz after the U.S. sank five Iranian tankers; Reuters reported multiple merchant vessel impacts, an LNG tanker damaged at Khor Fakkan, Brent above $100 and Hormuz flows as low as about 2 million bpd.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Iran and US hit tankers in biggest wave of attacks on shipping since war began

records.boundary: The 2 million bpd figure is a point estimate for Hormuz oil flows and cannot be applied directly to LNG or LPG volumes.

records.title: Oil vessel transit costs through Hormuz escalated after Iran war, ENOC exec says
records.claim: ENOC director said cargo insurance could reach 5%-6% of cargo value, additional war risk premiums up to 10%, and transit costs roughly $10-$20 million, while willing shipowners were limited.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Oil vessel transit costs through Hormuz escalated after Iran war, ENOC exec says

records.boundary: These are observed high-end/industry examples, not a complete market-wide average quote.

records.title: One third of Gulf oil is still missing despite 'dark crossings', data shows
records.claim: Reuters analysis put industry consensus Gulf oil exports including dark crossings at roughly 15-16 million bpd, around two-thirds of pre-war levels; Vortexa estimated August exports around 15 million bpd and seven-day Hormuz crude/product flows around 8 million bpd.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: One third of Gulf oil is still missing despite 'dark crossings', data shows

records.boundary: Dark crossings are inherently uncertain and estimates differ among trackers; single-day peaks are not sustained flow.

records.title: China oil demand to fall 8.9% in 2026, Sinopec research says
records.claim: Sinopec research arm forecast China oil demand down 600,000 bpd or 8.9% in 2026, gasoline down 8.7%, diesel down 11.4%, and 80-100 million tpy of smaller simple refining capacity potentially exiting by 2030.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: China oil demand to fall 8.9% in 2026, Sinopec research says

records.boundary: This is an annual research forecast, not realized September demand or an official monthly consumption statistic.

records.title: Aster buys crude from Americas, Africa to replace Middle East supply
records.claim: Singapore's Aster said it bought crude from the Americas and Africa to replace part of Middle Eastern supply; it previously sourced about 70% of crude from the Middle East and operates a 237,000 bpd refinery.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Aster buys crude from Americas, Africa to replace Middle East supply

records.boundary: Aster is one refinery; the article does not disclose replacement volume, duration, price differential or incremental freight.

data_gaps: No accepted same-window JKM/TTF/CP-FEI/VLGC/LNGC complete price/freight series.
No verified commodity-specific Hormuz loss ratio for LNG or LPG.
No same-window market-wide war-risk insurance average transaction quote.
No disclosed Aster replacement purchase volume, duration or incremental freight.
